speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Through the foresight and dedication of Singaporeans over the past 50 years, we have built an endearing home and a clean and green city with high environmental standards that we can be proud of.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As we embark on the next chapter of our nation's growth, we will build on this rich legacy so that a sustainable environment will become an intrinsic part of our unique Singaporean heritage.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work with Singaporeans, the larger community and industry partners to realise our vision for a Liveable and Endearing Home, a Vibrant and Sustainable City and an Active and Gracious Community.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work hard to achieve an even cleaner and healthier environment whilst ensuring that Singaporeans continue to have access to fresh air and clean water.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also strengthen our regulatory regime to ensure more stringent levels of food hygiene and leverage scientific advancements to minimise the transmission of vector-borne diseases.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As our population grows, the demands on our existing infrastructure to meet our daily waste management needs will increase significantly.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Given our land and resource constraints, we will leverage innovative technologies and solutions to uphold our high standards of waste management.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: At the same time, we will encourage and facilitate the efforts of Singaporeans to reuse, reduce and recycle more as we work towards a Zero Waste Nation.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Everyone has a part to play in upholding high standards of cleanliness and public health.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work closely with the community to reinforce these positive social norms such that it becomes an inherent part of our Singaporean identity and values.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will empower the community and provide more opportunities, such as extending the "Bright Spots" programme, for individuals to adopt greater ownership of our environment and to nurture values of graciousness and mutual respect together.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We recognise that spaces are important in connecting individuals and forming communities that care for our environment together.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our hawker centres not only provide hygienic and affordable food, but are also well-loved and vibrant community spaces that enrich our lives.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We have embarked on a review to strengthen the role of hawker centres, support innovation and work with the community to promote our local hawker culture and social graciousness.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: More of our new hawker centres will be integrated with facilities and spaces for meaningful daily interactions among residents.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will also further expand our ABC Waters Programme to transform more waterways and waterbodies into recreational, social and community spaces closer to our homes and hearts.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We are actively engaging and co-creating with our citizens during the design and construction phases of the ABC Waters projects, as well as working with them to keep our waterways and waterbodies clean.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Economic growth and environmental sustainability are not mutually exclusive.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work with industry partners and regional governments to support economic growth in an 	Page: 51 environmentally responsible manner.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our experience with transboundary haze in the past few years has shown the devastating environmental, social and economic impact of irresponsible business practices.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will take decisive and sustained action to tackle haze, such as increasing collaboration with industries and key interest groups, to adopt sustainable land clearing practices.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will not hesitate to take tough actions against errant businesses.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Singapore is a responsible global citizen and we have put in place ambitious plans to achieve our pledge.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: This requires all of us – the Government, industries and individuals – to each play our part to reduce our greenhouse gas emissions.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Significant adjustments will be needed as we put in place higher emission standards.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will work with industries to adopt greener practices and enhance their energy efficiency.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: As individuals, we will also need to reduce our energy consumption and, to enable this, we will share more information under our energy labelling scheme and work with community groups to drive greener purchasing decisions.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Our Government, as a large consumer of goods and services, remains committed to taking the lead in sustainability and will do more through more ambitious energy and water efficiency targets for the public sector.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Lastly, we are keenly aware of our vulnerability as an island state with limited resources.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: While we continue to do our part in reducing our carbon footprint, we need to protect ourselves from the wide-ranging impacts of climate change.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Singapore takes a proactive, long-term approach towards climate adaptation.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: We will build greater resilience into our infrastructure and systems within MEWR.

speaker: The Minister for the Environment and Water Resources (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
text: Just as our forefathers have left us this City in the Garden, we must leave our children with a greener and cleaner home.
